assertions.name: R12_even_palindromic
assertions.unit: bool (0 = R12 even in q AND palindromic)

assertions.name: R12_reduces_to_cubic_in_y
assertions.unit: bool (0 = C(q^2+q^-2)*q^6 == R12 exactly, deg C = 3)
assertions.source: exact power-sum → Chebyshev reduction in y = q^2+q^-2.

assertions.name: C_irreducible_over_Q
assertions.unit: bool (0 = no rational root ⇒ irreducible cubic over Q)

description: Identify the non-cyclotomic residual R_12 of the Q_beta bar-odd carrier: even+palindromic ⇒ a cubic C(y)=y^3-4y^2+3y-2 in the bar-even loop-trace variable y=q^2+q^-2. (bean 0zr0 Task 1)

data.verdict: R_12 is NOT cyclotomic (Phi_4 refutation stands) but reduces exactly to a degree-3 polynomial C(y)=y^3-4y^2+3y-2 in the bar-even trace variable y=q^2+q^-2; irreducible over Q (no rational root); one real branch y0~3.507 (real q>1). The odd carrier's non-cyclotomic content lives in Q[y], deg 3.
